Whether the CYBER cross-chain bridge was exploited remains a testable hypothesis, not a confirmed conclusion. My assessment is that before the official investigation report is released, the market is more likely to price in the mechanism risk of “minting authority and lockup verification” than to price in confirmed losses. This assessment hinges on there being a causal link between the anomalous minting and the outflow of funds locked in the bridge; if the two were merely coincidental in timing, the assessment would need to be revised.

According to Cointelegraph, Cyber reported unexpected CYBER minting on Solana, followed by tokens flowing out of the Ethereum bridge’s lockup address, and the project has launched an investigation. South Korean exchanges Upbit and Bithumb suspended CYBER deposits and withdrawals. These are confirmed facts. The source material provided here does not explain how an attacker might have bypassed verification or the scale of any losses, so those details cannot be added.

Mechanically, cross-chain bridges typically rely on consistency between the ledgers on both ends: assets are locked on one end, while representative assets are minted on the other according to a set of rules. If the minting side can operate independently of lockup verification, assets in the bridge are exposed to the risk of “unbacked minting.” On this basis, the exchanges’ suspension of deposits and withdrawals can be inferred to be a risk-containment measure intended to prevent anomalous tokens from continuing to flow into order books, rather than a definitive judgment on the nature of the incident.

Scenario analysis: If the official investigation confirms that minting authority was bypassed, market attention will shift to the remaining assets in the bridge and the verification designs of similar bridges, with risk potentially spreading to cross-chain assets that use similar mechanisms. If the investigation instead finds a configuration error or an internal process issue, the impact will likely be more limited to CYBER itself. The official report and on-chain fund flows will determine which scenario is triggered.

There are three indicators worth tracking: whether the official investigation report is published and what it concludes, the on-chain movements of the anomalously minted tokens, and when exchanges resume CYBER deposits and withdrawals. Until this information is clear, my view is that the mechanism risk is now in focus, but the losses and attribution of responsibility remain unknown. This article does not constitute investment advice.

CYBER跨链桥是否被利用，目前只能算一个可检验的假设，而非已确认结论。我的判断是：在官方调查报告公布前，市场更可能先对“铸造权限与锁仓验证”这一机制风险定价，而不是对确定损失定价。这个判断成立的前提，是异常铸造与桥锁仓资金外流之间存在因果关联；若二者只是时间上的巧合，判断需要修正。

据Cointelegraph报道，Cyber报告Solana上出现意外的CYBER铸造，随后有代币从以太坊桥的锁仓地址流出，项目方已启动调查；韩国交易所Upbit与Bithumb暂停了CYBER充提。这些是已确认的事实。至于攻击者如何绕过验证、损失规模多少，本次素材未提供，不能补写。

从机制上看，跨链桥通常依赖两端账本的一致性：一端锁定资产，另一端按规则铸造代表资产。一旦铸造端能脱离锁仓验证单独执行，桥内资产就暴露在“无抵押铸造”的风险下。据此推断，交易所暂停充提是在阻断异常代币继续流入订单簿，属于风险隔离动作，而非对事件性质的定性。

情景推演：若官方调查确认铸造权限被绕过，市场关注点会转向桥内剩余资产和同类桥的验证设计，风险可能向使用相似机制的跨链资产传导；若调查显示为配置错误或内部流程问题，影响范围则更局限于CYBER本身。两种情景的触发条件，都以官方报告和链上资金流向为准。

值得跟踪的验证指标有三项：官方调查报告是否公布及结论、异常铸造代币的链上流向、交易所恢复充提的时间。在这些信息明确前，我的观察是机制风险已被摆上台面，但损失与责任归属仍属未知。本文不构成投资建议。

Knowledge Card: Public Blockchains and the Blockchain Trilemma
Increasing block capacity and shortening block times can improve throughput, but also raise the hardware and bandwidth requirements for running a node.
EVM-compatible public blockchains can run Ethereum-format smart contracts directly, such as BNB Smart Chain and Avalanche's C-Chain.
When transferring assets between different public blockchains, check that the networks match. The same token usually has a different contract on each chain.
$ETH  is the native coin of Ethereum, a Layer 1 public blockchain, and is used to pay gas fees and stake.

【In the early days of the internet, those who built the roads were worth more】
Around 1999, the ones who made it big were often not the PC assemblers, but the teams building network and payment infrastructure. ETH should be viewed the same way: don’t focus only on its price—it’s more like a public road for assets.

The key concept behind ETH is “programmable collateral.” Just as banks take real estate as collateral, smart contracts automatically assess ETH’s value, calculate margin requirements, and trigger liquidations. BTCS holds $54 million in Aave loans and has alerted the SEC to the possibility of liquidation; even after reducing its debt by about $10 million over ten days, it still wasn’t enough. What does this tell us? Price swings directly affect corporate balance sheets, forcing lenders, treasury companies, and liquidity providers to reprice risk.

As an investment, ETH is more than an asset that goes up or down—it’s also collateral and a settlement tool. The Fear and Greed Index is at 11, with its weekly average also at 11, yet ETH has risen 3.3% in 24 hours. This kind of divergence has often looked like a bottom in the past, but it’s no signal to blindly buy the dip. Watch the support at 1613.28 and resistance at 1753.12: only a high-volume break above the latter would show that the road is truly open.

Remember: when looking at ETH, don’t just ask “How much is it worth?” Ask how many real businesses are willing to use it for financing and settlement. The more tangible the demand, the stronger its value as collateral.

If you work in AI, Web3, or RWA, do you see ETH more as collateral or as a settlement layer?

#ETH #加密分析 #WASTED #Market Insights

content:
【互联网早期，先修路的人更值钱】
1999年前后，跑出来的往往不是组装电脑的人，而是网络和支付基础设施团队。ETH也该这么看：别只盯价格，它更像一条承载资产的公共路。

ETH最关键的概念，是“可编程抵押品”。像银行拿房产抵押，智能合约会自动识别ETH价值、计算保证金、触发清算。BTCS持有5400万美元Aave贷款，并向SEC提示可能遭清算；十天减债约1000万美元仍不够。这说明什么？价格波动会直接打进企业资产负债表，贷款机构、财库公司和流动性提供者都得重新定价风险。

投资上，ETH不只是涨跌标的，更是抵押品和结算工具。恐惧贪婪指数已到11、周均也是11，ETH却24小时涨3.3%，这种背离历史上常像底部特征，但不是抄底按钮。盯住1613.28支撑、1753.12阻力：放量站上后者，才算路真通了。

记住一点：看ETH，不只看“值多少钱”，更看多少真实业务愿意拿它融资、结算。需求越实，抵押品价值越硬。

如果你做AI、Web3或RWA，你更看好ETH做抵押品，还是做结算层？

1,711.08 has been broken, with a wick down to 1,538 before a roughly 10% rebound: I’m not treating this bounce as confirmation of a bottom

Last time, I said I wouldn’t treat the area around 1,711 as confirmation of a new bottom. I’d first want to see the daily chart hold 1,711.08 and reclaim 1,835.35, then see whether U.S. spot ETH ETFs have a day of genuinely sizable net inflows, with ETHA no longer at zero or showing net outflows. If ETH fell back below 1,732.83 and then broke 1,711.08, I’d look for lower levels again. As it turned out, the daily low on 11/20 was 1,581.47 and the close was 1,623.09—already below 1,711.08. On 11/21, it wicked down to 1,538.00 on the 1-minute candle at 12:09 Taipei time, setting a new low for this move. The 11/21 daily candle closed at 1,685.63. It was a bullish candle, but still closed below 1,711.08. I won’t treat 1,538 as confirmation of a new bottom just because the price has rebounded about 11.1% from its low.

Binance spot data (11/22, 19:25 Taipei time): ETH around 1,709, up 4.2% over 24 hours, with a range of 1,640.33–1,723.88; BTC around 60,963 (+5.3%); SOL around 70.77 (+3.7%). On Binance’s UTC weekly chart (weekly open and close at 08:00 Monday Taipei time), ETH has now closed six consecutive bearish weekly candles. This week opened at 1,835.35 and is currently down about 6.9%; its low so far is 1,538.00 on 11/21. Over the same period, BTC is down about 6.7% and SOL about 2.7%. If the weekly candle still closes below 1,835.35 at 08:00 on 11/23 Taipei time (Monday), it will be the seventh consecutive bearish weekly candle. The last time ETH closed seven consecutive bearish weekly candles was the seven weeks from 1/19 to 3/2 this year. The current price is about 11.1% above 1,538.00 and about 0.1% below 1,711.08.

The flows haven’t followed through. Farside shows net outflows from U.S. spot ETH ETFs for four consecutive days—11/16, 11/17, 11/18, and 11/19—of $8.4 million, $29.1 million, $39.8 million, and $131.2 million, respectively, for a total of about $208.5 million over the four days. On 11/19 alone, ETHA saw outflows of $124.2 million. Across the 14 trading days through 11/19, November saw total net outflows of about $972.6 million. Only 11/4 and 11/13 had net inflows (the data only goes through 11/19; ETHA and other major funds have not yet reported for 11/20, while the other funds have already shown combined net outflows of $13.2 million, which I’m not including for now). On the derivatives side, Binance ETH perpetual open interest fell from about 2.495 million ETH at 16:00 on 11/20 to about 2.313 million ETH at 16:00 on 11/21, a drop of about 7.3%. At 16:00 on 11/22 it was about 2.324 million, so it hasn’t recovered. The funding rate reached -0.0188% in the period ending at 08:00 on 11/21. The latest reading (16:00 on 11/22) is -0.0011%, close to zero.

What does this mean? (The following is my inference.)
After the daily close broke below 1,711.08, no new wave of buying emerged to push the price back up. Instead, it first made a new low at 1,538.00. The price has rebounded about 11.1% from the low, but open interest still hasn’t returned to its 11/20 high, and ETF flows through 11/19 showed no inflows. In the previous leveraged bounce, selling pressure materialized as soon as the price turned back down. This looks more like a wick-and-rebound during a decline than confirmation of a bottom.

My view: I won’t treat the area around 1,538 as confirmation of a new bottom, or say the decline has stopped just because of this roughly 11.1% rebound. I’m watching three things next: a daily close holding above 1,538.00 and reclaiming 1,711.08; the weekly candle closing back above 1,835.35 at 08:00 on 11/23, avoiding a seventh consecutive bearish weekly candle; and a day of genuinely sizable net inflows into U.S. spot ETH ETFs, with ETHA turning positive. To say the trend is strengthening, ETH still needs to reclaim 2,000, or even 2,127.46 (the close for the week of 11/2). Until these things happen, I see this as a bounce after a decline, not the start of a reversal. If it breaks below 1,538.00 again, I’ll look for lower levels rather than rush to call a bottom. 上次我说，不会把 1,711 附近当成新的底部确认，要先看日线守住 1,711.08、重新站回 1,835.35，再看美国现货 ETH ETF 有没有一天真正有规模的净流入，而且 ETHA 不再是 0 或净流出；如果跌回 1,732.83 下方、再破 1,711.08，我会重新找下方位置。结果 11/20 日线最低 1,581.47、收盘 1,623.09，已经收在 1,711.08 下方；11/21（台北时间 12:09 那根 1 分钟线）又插针到 1,538.00，这是这一轮新低。11/21 日线收在 1,685.63，虽然是阳线，但仍收在 1,711.08 下方。我不会因为从最低点反弹了约 11.1%，就把 1,538 当成新的底部确认。

Binance 现货数据（11/22 19:25 台北时间）：ETH 约 1,709，24 小时 +4.2%，区间 1,640.33–1,723.88；BTC 约 60,963（+5.3%），SOL 约 70.77（+3.7%）。以 Binance UTC 周线（台北时间周一 08:00 开收）看，ETH 已经连收六根周阴线，本周从 1,835.35 开盘，到目前约 -6.9%，本周最低就是 11/21 的 1,538.00，同期 BTC 约 -6.7%，SOL 约 -2.7%。如果台北时间 11/23（周一）08:00 周线收盘还在 1,835.35 下方，就是第七根；上一次 ETH 连收七根周阴线，是今年 1/19 到 3/2 那七周。现价比 1,538.00 高约 11.1%，比 1,711.08 低约 0.1%。

资金面没有跟上。Farside 显示，美国现货 ETH ETF 11/16、11/17、11/18、11/19 连续四天净流出，分别是 840 万、2,910 万、3,980 万、1.312 亿美元，四天合计约 2.085 亿美元；11/19 单日 ETHA 就流出 1.242 亿美元。11 月到 11/19 的十四个交易日合计约净流出 9.726 亿美元，还是只有 11/4 和 11/13 两天是净流入（数据只算到 11/19；11/20 的 ETHA 等主力还未公布，其它基金合计已显示净流出 1,320 万美元，这笔我先不计入）。合约这边，Binance ETH 永续持仓量从 11/20 16:00 约 249.5 万 ETH，降到 11/21 16:00 约 231.3 万 ETH，少了约 7.3%；11/22 16:00 约 232.4 万，没有补回。资金费率 11/21 08:00 那期到过 -0.0188%，最新一期（11/22 16:00）-0.0011%，接近零。

这代表什么？（以下是我的推论）
1,711.08 日线收盘破了之后，并没有出现新的买盘把价格拉回去，反而先打出 1,538.00 的新低。从最低点反弹约 11.1%，持仓量却还没回到 11/20 的高点，ETF 到 11/19 也没有流入。上次那波杠杆反弹，价格一回头就把卖压兑现了。这次更像是下跌过程中的插针回拉，不是底部确认。

我的判断：我不会把 1,538 附近当成新的底部确认，也不会因为这次反弹了约 11.1%，就说止跌了。接下来我看三件事：日线收盘守住 1,538.00，并重新站回 1,711.08；周线在 11/23 08:00 收回 1,835.35 上方，躲掉第七根周阴线；美国现货 ETH ETF 出现一天真正有规模的净流入，而且 ETHA 转成流入。若要说转强，还是要重新站回 2,000，甚至 2,127.46（11/2 那周收盘）。这些都没出现之前，我的看法是下跌之后的回拉，不是开始反转。如果再破 1,538.00，我会再重新找下方位置，而不是急着当成底部。这只是我自己的观察门槛，不是买卖信号。

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where Should You Place Your Stop-Loss? How I Choose Between Technical Levels and Percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss takes more thought than whether you set one at all. Too close, and you get stopped out every day; too far, and one loss can really hurt.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. It’s simple and straightforward, and suitable for beginners
to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might end up right in a cluster of other traders’ stops.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the market structure is invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if this level breaks, that’s evidence I was wrong.
Work backward from your position size: if the stop is far away, reduce your position size to ensure the loss on any single trade is still only a set percentage of your capital.

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一

because everyone who was going to run has already run, yet people are still shorting. Many major rebounds in history began at times like these.

translatedData.content:
Morgan Stanley ETH Trust discloses staked holdings | Not new buying today | I’m waiting for confirmation at 1725

My stance is cautiously bullish, but when it comes to the phrase “institutions hold ETH,” the first thing to check is the reporting date. The Morgan Stanley Ethereum Trust’s quarterly report in the U.S. SEC filings describes the situation as of September 30, 2026: the trust held approximately 20,000.265 ETH, with a book fair value of about $53.89 million, of which approximately $37.72 million worth of ETH was staked—around 70% of ETH’s fair value at the time. The filing was signed by management on November 13. It reflects the fund’s holdings and operations at a historical point in time; it does not mean Morgan Stanley bought 20,000 ETH today, and the book value at the end of September should not be treated as the current market price. The trust only began operations on July 27, and the report also explicitly notes that directly comparable data for the same period last year is unavailable.

What makes this filing worth reading is how it addresses the control and liquidity arrangements for staked assets. It states that the service provider uses validator keys to participate in validation, while the withdrawal address for the underlying ETH still points to the fund’s custodied cold wallet. Staked assets are deposited into the Ethereum protocol’s deposit contract; exiting requires an unstaking process in accordance with the fund’s liquidity management arrangements, and there is also a risk of slashing for validator misconduct. An institution staking some of its existing ETH holdings may reduce the immediate availability of those assets for sale and earn rewards, but the fund still has to manage subscriptions, redemptions, and expenses. Staking rewards also do not mean that fund shareholders receive an equivalent return risk-free. What can actually affect spot supply and demand is subsequent net fund subscriptions and redemptions, changes in holdings, and the actual staking ratio—not the headline of a single old report.

On the market side, ETH/USDT on Binance was around 1711.62 when I last checked, up approximately 4.34% over 24 hours, with a range of 1639.05 to 1723.88. The rise is a fact, but there is no evidence that it was driven by this mid-November disclosure of a report covering the end of September. Farside shows total net outflows of approximately $131.2 million from U.S. ETH-related funds on November 19. On November 20, some major funds on the page were still blank, so the aggregate of the figures already shown should not be treated as a complete final flow. Spot markets continue trading over the weekend, while fund subscription and redemption data are not refreshed in sync; the two markets run on different clocks. 1725 is the confirmation zone around the current high, 1700 is near-term support, and 1650 is the structural line in the sand. If the price breaks above 1725 but quickly falls back below 1700, I will consider the breakout unsupported.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and consider only a small spot long position. The entry trigger would be a 4-hour close holding above 1725, followed by a retest of 1700–1725 that holds, with no further large net outflows after the next complete set of fund data is released. If those conditions are met, I would risk no more than 4% of total capital on a trial position, without using high leverage. The first target is 1760; I would take half off there and move the stop on the remainder to around breakeven. The second target is 1820, where I would close most of the remaining position. The initial stop would be below 1650. I would exit if a 4-hour candle closes below 1650 or if a staked fund faces a clear custody security issue. If the only catalyst is a brief spike prompted by a report of old holdings, I will remain flat; a plan whose triggers have not been met is not a trade.

Sources: Morgan Stanley Ethereum Trust quarterly report filed with the SEC; Farside fund flows table; Binance ETH/USDT spot market data. #ETH
The above is only my personal market commentary and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
摩根士丹利ETH信托披露质押存量｜不是今天新增买盘｜我等1725确认

我的态度是谨慎偏多，但对“机构持有ETH”四个字要先看报表日期。美国SEC档案中的Morgan Stanley Ethereum Trust季度报告，披露的是截至2026年9月30日的情况：信托持有约20000.265枚ETH，账面公允价值约5389万美元，其中约3772万美元的ETH处于质押状态，占当时ETH公允价值的大约七成。文件由管理层在11月13日签署；这是历史时点的基金存量和运作方式，不等于今天摩根士丹利新买入两万枚ETH，更不能拿九月底的账面价格当成现在的成交价。信托7月27日才开始运营，报告也明确缺少可直接比较的上一年同期数据。

这份文件值得读的地方是质押资产的控制与流动性安排。文件说明，服务商使用验证者密钥参与验证，底层ETH的提现地址仍指向基金托管的冷钱包；质押资产进入以太坊协议存款合约，退出需要按基金流动性管理安排解绑，同时存在验证者违规被罚没的风险。机构把部分存量ETH投入质押，可能减少这部分资产的即时可售性并产生奖励，但基金仍需处理申赎和费用；质押收益也不等于基金份额持有人无风险拿到同等回报。真正能影响现货供需的，是此后基金净申赎、持仓变化和实际质押比例，而不是单次旧报表标题。

市场端，刚查看币安ETH/USDT约1711.62，24小时上涨约4.34%，区间1639.05至1723.88。上涨是事实，却没有证据证明由这份11月中旬披露的九月底报表推动。Farside显示11月19日美国ETH相关基金合计净流出约1.312亿美元；11月20日页面部分主要基金仍留空，已显示的合计数不能当完整最终流量。周末现货继续交易，基金申赎数据却不会同步刷新，两个市场时钟不同。1725是眼前高点的确认区域，1700是近端支撑，1650是结构防线；若冲过1725又迅速回落到1700下方，我会把突破视为未被承接。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向仅考虑现货小仓位做多。入场触发是4小时收盘站稳1725，回踩1700至1725不破，并在下一次完整基金数据公布后没有进一步大幅净流出；满足后最多用总资金4%试仓，不使用高杠杆。第一目标1760，到位减仓一半并把剩余止损提至成本附近；第二目标1820，再减掉大部分。初始止损设在1650下方，4小时收盘跌破1650或质押基金出现明确托管安全问题时平仓。若只有旧持仓报道引起的短时冲高，我保持空仓；未触发的计划不算成交。

来源：SEC所载Morgan Stanley Ethereum Trust季度报告；Farside资金表；币安ETH/USDT现货行情。#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

title: Rússia Legaliza Cripto nas Exchanges: Mas Com Uma Armadilha Para o Retalho
subTitle:
🇷🇺 Rússia Legaliza Cripto nas Exchanges: Mas Com Uma Armadilha Para o Retalho
A Rússia acaba de dar um passo gigante.
A partir de 22 de novembro de 2026, a negociação organizada de criptomoedas em exchanges está autorizada, desde que as regras sejam aprovadas pelo banco central.
Já existem cerca de 30 operadores licenciados, incluindo bancos gigantes como Sberbank e VTB.
A Bolsa de Moscovo vai começar um projeto-piloto a partir de 1 de dezembro de 2026, só com $BTC , $ETH  e USDT, com liquidação pelo National Clearing Centre. Tudo será reportado ao regulador.
O QUE MUDA PARA O RUSSO COMUM?
Aqui está a armadilha.
Investidor comum não qualificado:
Só pode comprar um pequeno conjunto de moedas aprovadas e está limitado a cerca de 300.000 rublos por ano por intermediário, e ainda tem que passar num teste básico.
Investidor qualificado:
Sem limite de compra e acesso a muito mais ativos.
E atenção: pagar bens e serviços dentro da Rússia com cripto continua PROIBIDO. Cripto só é permitida para pagamentos transfronteiriços.
Ou seja: abriu, mas com muito controlo.
E PARA O MERCADO GLOBAL, ISSO É BOM OU MAU?
É um sinal forte: a Rússia aceita cripto como classe de ativo negociável.
Mas não esperes uma onda massiva de compra já. Os limites do retalho + o piloto pequeno significam volumes iniciais contidos, concentrados em BTC,  ETH e USDT contra o rublo.
E tem risco: a Bolsa de Moscovo e o seu centro de compensação estão sob sanções dos EUA, e o USDT está sujeito a controlos do emissor sobre entidades sancionadas.
CONCLUSÃO
A Rússia tirou a cripto da zona cinzenta e colocou dentro do sistema financeiro tradicional, mas com rédea curta.
No curto prazo, é uma procura modesta e monitorizada. No longo prazo, vai depender de como a Rússia equilibra os limites, as sanções e o uso transfronteiriço.
E tu? Achas que outros países sancionados vão copiar a Rússia ou isso é só uma forma de controlar a cripto?
Comenta COPIAR ou CONTROLAR 👇
Isto é apenas a minha opinião, não é conselho financeiro

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours, and it’s a payment between longs and shorts
that they make to each other. The exchange simply collects and distributes the payment; it doesn’t profit from it.

[Mechanism] Perpetual contracts have no settlement date, so how does their price stay in line with the spot price? That’s what the funding rate is for:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (sellers have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money flows back and forth between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant; it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds required to open a position. For example, with 10x leverage, it’s 10% of the position size.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: Once losses eat into the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

TVL is not the same as protocol revenue, user numbers, or trading volume.

ETH Fund Trading Rules Adjusted｜Existing Products Shift to Generic Listing Standards｜I’m Still Waiting for Confirmation at 1720

My stance is cautious. Regulatory filings are worth reading, but a procedural adjustment should not be presented as new capital entering the market. ETH appeared in Binance Square’s Most Searched list over the past six hours. There is no accurate Trending Topics hashtag directly related to this filing, so I’m using only #ETH. An SEC exchange-rule filing published on November 16 shows that the Invesco Galaxy Bitcoin ETF and Invesco Galaxy Ethereum ETF, which Cboe BZX had previously been authorized to list and trade, are proposed to operate under the exchange’s current generic listing standards for commodity-based trust shares. The SEC agreed to shorten the usual 30-day waiting period, allowing the rule amendment to take effect upon filing. The filing emphasizes that the products will continue to meet ongoing listing requirements. At its core, this concerns the listing-rule framework applicable to existing products; it is not approval of an entirely new ETH fund in November, nor does it disclose how much ETH the fund bought today.

Why pay attention, then? Clear, consistent listing standards could reduce rule-related friction for exchanges managing similar products and make institutional access channels more stable. But the immediate change is to the regulatory and listing framework; any impact on prices would depend on subsequent steps such as investor subscriptions, actual net inflows into funds, and spot hedging. The SEC retains the power to temporarily suspend the amendment within 60 days of filing, and procedural effectiveness does not amount to an endorsement of fund returns or the price of ETH. Equating “listing rules have changed” directly with “institutions are buying ETH” confuses the legal effect of the filing with actual capital flows.

The market reaction has not confirmed such a strong causal link. At around 17:34 Beijing time on November 22, ETH/USDT on Binance was about $1,689.57, up approximately 3.08% over 24 hours, with a low of 1635 and a high of 1716.58. The gain is real, but there is no evidence attributing it to the November 16 filing. Farside shows total net outflows of approximately $131.2 million from U.S. ETH funds on November 19. Several major entries for November 20 were still blank, so an incomplete table should not be treated as evidence of a broad return to net inflows by Friday. There were also no new regular-trading-day fund subscription and redemption figures on the same basis over the weekend. I’ll watch both whether the price can break through the 1717–1720 area and the complete fund-flow table for the next trading day, rather than focusing on a single regulatory headline.

If I were trading this myself, I would not chase the price right now; I would consider only a small spot long position. The entry trigger would be a four-hour close holding above $1,720, followed by a retest that holds between 1700 and 1720, with no significant net outflows in the data for the next U.S. fund trading day. If any one of these three conditions is missing, I stay out. If they are all met, I would invest 5% of my investable funds, take half off at $1,760, then sell half of the remaining position at $1,820, and trail the rest using four-hour lows. I would set the initial stop-loss at $1,650 and close the entire position on a confirmed four-hour break below it. If the price first spikes and then falls back below 1680, or complete fund data continues to deteriorate, I would exit early. A break below 1635 would invalidate my view that this recovery is underway; I would wait for new evidence before reassessing.

Sources: SEC filing 34-106904, Farside ETH fund flow table, Binance spot market data. This is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH基金交易规则调整｜现有产品转通用上市标准｜我仍等1720确认

我的态度是谨慎，监管文件值得读，但不能把程序性调整写成新的资金入场。币安广场六小时Most Searched有ETH；当前Trending Topics没有与这份文件直接对应的准确话题标签，因此只用#ETH。美国SEC 11月16日公布的交易所规则文件显示，Cboe BZX此前已获准上市并交易的Invesco Galaxy Bitcoin ETF与Invesco Galaxy Ethereum ETF，拟改为依据该交易所现行的商品信托份额通用上市标准运行。SEC同意缩短通常的30天等待期，让规则修订在提交时生效。文件强调产品继续符合持续上市要求，核心是现有产品适用的上市规则路径，不是11月又批准一只全新的ETH基金，也没有披露基金今天购买了多少ETH。

为什么仍要关注？清晰、统一的上市标准可能降低交易所管理同类产品的规则摩擦，使机构配置渠道更稳定；但它首先改变的是监管与挂牌框架，价格影响需要经过投资者申购、基金实际净流入和现货对冲等后续环节。SEC保留在提交后60天内临时暂停该修订的权力，程序性生效也不等于对基金收益或ETH价格背书。将“上市规则已调整”直接等同于“机构正在买入ETH”，会把文件的法律效果和资金流事实混淆。

市场反应并未验证这种强因果。北京时间11月22日17时34分附近，币安ETH/USDT约1689.57美元，24小时上涨约3.08%，区间低点1635、高点1716.58；涨幅确实存在，但没有证据归因于这份11月16日文件。Farside显示11月19日美国ETH基金合计净流出约1.312亿美元；11月20日多个主要分项仍空白，不能把不完整的表格当作周五全面转净流入。周末本身也没有同口径的新增常规交易日基金申赎数据。我会同时看价格能否越过1717至1720区域，以及下一交易日完整的资金表，而不是只看一条监管标题。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与追高，方向只考虑现货小仓做多。入场触发是四小时收盘站稳1720美元，随后回踩1700至1720不破，并且下一美国基金交易日数据未再出现显著净流出；三项缺一就空仓。满足后投入可投资资金的5%，1760美元先减半，1820美元再减余仓一半，剩余以四小时低点跟踪。初始止损设在1650美元，四小时有效跌破全部平仓；如果先冲高后跌回1680，或完整基金数据继续恶化，我会提前撤退。跌破1635美元将推翻本轮修复判断，等待新事实再评估。

来源：SEC文件34-106904、Farside ETH基金资金表、币安现货行情。以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

$NVDAB: NVDAB: Auction Theory Meets Breakout Candles

$NVDAB: NVDAB is moving upward while volume sits above its baseline, prompting the question: can live‑auction dynamics help explain a breakout candle? In a traditional auction, each bidder sees the current price and decides whether to raise the bid based on perceived competition. If we treat a candle as a single “round” of bidding, the price at the close represents the final winning bid, while the volume spike reflects how many participants entered the round.

One way to model this is to imagine a sealed‑bid auction where each trader submits a hidden order at the start of the hour. The highest order that clears the market becomes the closing price, and the number of orders that actually execute determines the observed volume. When 7.09x the baseline is observed, it suggests many hidden bids converged, raising the likelihood that the closing price overshoots the prior resistance.

A counterexample would be a candle with modest volume despite a price rise; the same auction analogy would predict fewer participants and a weaker price push. To reassess, watch the next closed hourly candle: if the price retreats while 74.3 stays neutral, the auction‑style explanation loses strength. Conversely, a repeat of high volume and upward price would reinforce the hypothesis without proving causation.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

От водителя такси до миллиардера: Чему Брюс Ковнер научил трейдеров глобальных трендов

История
Брюс Ковнер не начинал в кресле аналитика на Уолл-стрит. В молодости он менял профессии, водил такси, пробовал себя в академической науке и долго искал свой путь. В трейдинг он пришёл уже в зрелом возрасте — около 30 лет — и в 1983 году основал легендарный фонд Caxton Associates.
Вместо того чтобы угадывать каждую свечу, Ковнер мыслил глобальными цепочками событий: как неурожай, решение центрального банка или сдвиг в цепочках поставок отзовётся на десятках рынков сразу. При этом он славился жёстким отношением к себе: если позиция шла против его сценария, он сокращал её без долгих споров с самим собой и не превращал идею в личную гордость.

title: 半个月从2251砸到1538，盯完ETH四小时图真有点不是滋味
subTitle:
周日下午本来想歇会儿不看盘，结果手贱把 $ETH 四小时图往左缩了一下，看着左上角 11 月 8 号那个 2,251.54 的高点，再看看这两天刚砸出来的 1,538.00，心里真有点堵得慌。两周硬生生跌掉七百多刀，超三成的回撤放在主流币里，真没几个人能笑着扛过来。

最折磨人的还不是一路阴跌，而是中间那段“假企稳”。13、14 号连着两天从 2,021 砸穿 1,730 时，不少人已经交了筹码；结果 15 号到 19 号它又缩回 1,730 到 1,867 磨了五天，K 线贴着均线走得四平八稳，不少刚止损的人拍断大腿又追回去抄底，想着总算熬出头了吧。结果 20 号一根大阴线直接带量砸穿 1,600，日线砸出 11.1 亿美元成交额，21 号顺势一脚踹到 1,538。刚以为地板结实了准备躺平，地板直接塌了。

回头看，昨晚 1,538 那根针确实有资金接了——当时 4 小时单根干出 3.56 亿成交量，硬把价格拉回 1,716.58，昨天全天现货爆出 10.1 亿。隔壁 $BTC 也猛，最低插到 55,130 后在 4 小时砸出 10.2 亿天量反抽到 60,996，现在还在 59,700 附近死磕六万关口，24 小时成交 15.6 亿。可对比之下 $ETH 就显得特别憋屈：美股标普、纳指跌破 200 日均线，外围情绪本来就紧，偏偏链上和消息面还一团糟——以太坊 ETF 单日净流出 1.62 万枚、CoinShares 清仓 ETH 国库，甚至被盗的五千多枚币还在链上乱转。每次恐慌一来，二饼永远跌得最干脆、弹得最犹豫。

现在 4 小时图看着特别明显，$ETH 报在 1,684.23（24h +2.87%，成交 5.53 亿），看似稳住，头顶其实压得死死的：MA25 就在 1,715.15 横着，昨天摸到 1,716.58 刚露头就被拍回来；MA99 更是高挂在 1,938.98。好在底下 MA7 刚拐到 1,674.61 托了一把，今天量能也快速缩下来了。说白了，1,538 的恐慌盘是被接走了一部分，但上面全是套牢盘，指望直接 V 反起飞真不现实。

我自己现在既不敢在 1,680 满仓追，也没胆在刚放量收回的位置空它。真要转强，起码得带量把 1,715 这条 MA25 踩实；要是晚上大饼六万站不住往下带节奏，还得防着二次回踩 1,580 到 1,600 附近。周末盘面磨人心态，现货党少盯分时图，杠杆别跟插针行情较劲，个人碎碎念，非投资建议。

translatedData.title: From 2,251 to 1,538 in half a month—looking at ETH’s four-hour chart really stings
translatedData.subTitle:
I was planning to take it easy and not look at the charts on Sunday afternoon, but I couldn’t help myself—I zoomed out on the $ETH  four-hour chart, saw the November 8 high of 2,251.54 in the upper-left corner, then looked at the 1,538.00 it had just plunged to over the past couple of days. It really left a knot in my stomach. It shed more than 700 bucks in just two weeks. A drawdown of over 30% is something very few people can stomach with a smile, even among the major coins.

The most brutal part wasn’t even the steady slide—it was that stretch of “false stability” in the middle. On the 13th and 14th, it plunged straight through 1,730 from 2,021 over two days, and plenty of people had already sold their positions. Then from the 15th to the 19th, it crept back into the 1,730–1,867 range and churned there for five days. The candlesticks hugged the moving averages, looking calm and steady. A lot of people who’d just cut their losses were kicking themselves and buying back in, thinking the worst was finally over. Then on the 20th, a huge bearish candle crashed straight through 1,600 on heavy volume, with daily trading volume hitting $1.11 billion. On the 21st, it took another leg down to 1,538. Just when you think the floor is solid and you can finally relax, it collapses beneath you.

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

translatedData.title: What's the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you'll be asked to choose “isolated” or “cross” margin. Many beginners tap one without thinking and end up taking a big loss.

【Cross Margin】Your entire account balance is used as collateral. Advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you're less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: in extreme market conditions, losses could wipe out your entire account. It's like putting all your eggs in one basket, where they prop each other up.
They prop each other up in the same basket.

【Isolated Margin】Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won't spread to your other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

【My recommendation】Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you don't yet have the ability to assess the worst-case loss on a bad trade

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

Wall Street closes at 4 p.m. Eastern. Palo Alto Networks, at least one version of it, now doesn’t close at all.

MF Markets, a self-custodial perpetual futures platform operated by MANTRA SPC, has listed Palo Alto Networks (PANW) for round-the-clock trading. Anyone with a crypto wallet can access it, and every position is backed by $USDC.

The listing lands at a busy moment for the cybersecurity giant. Palo Alto has recently posted strong quarterly numbers and announced a multibillion-dollar AI acquisition, the kind of news that tends to move a stock
What MF Markets is actually offering
MF Markets pitches itself as a single app for crypto, stocks, indices, commodities, and foreign exchange. Users fund one $USDC balance and trade across all of those markets from it.

The platform is self-custodial. Traders connect their own wallets rather than handing assets to a broker, and trades execute onchain against public order books.

The product is a perpetual futures contract, not the stock itself. A perpetual is a derivative that tracks an asset’s price without ever expiring. Traders take long or short positions on where the price is heading.

Buying PANW perps on MF Markets doesn’t make you a Palo Alto shareholder. You get price exposure, not voting rights or a seat at the annual meeting.

The platform’s toolkit includes market-specific leverage limits, take-profit and stop-loss orders, and real-time funding information. Those tools apply across asset classes, so a stock perp behaves much like a crypto perp on the same venue.

Funding is the mechanism that keeps a perpetual’s price anchored to the underlying asset. When the contract drifts above or below the reference price, one side of the market pays the other. The Cost of 50x Leverage

At 3:17 a.m., Li Ming stared at the candlestick chart on his phone, his eyes bloodshot.

He had done something even he thought was crazy: deposited his entire net worth of 300,000 USDT into his futures account and opened a 50x leveraged short on AIGENSYN. The reason was simple. The coin had risen 22 percent in a day, climbing from 0.01314 to 0.01815. He thought the rise was outrageous and that a pullback was inevitable.

“It can’t keep going up forever,” he muttered to himself, swiping his finger across the screen. He looked at the green number under unrealized P&L and felt pleased with himself. His entry price was 0.01750, and the current price was 0.01680, giving him an unrealized profit of more than 4,000.

He lit a cigarette, opened his WeChat group, and sent a message: “Boys, the bears are in position. When it pulls back, hot pot’s on me.”

Someone in the group replied, “Ming, you’re a legend.” Someone else cautioned him: “50x is way too risky. Leave yourself some room.”

Li Ming ignored them. He remembered the profit he’d made shorting ETHFI the previous month, from 0.52 down to 0.42—a threefold return. Back then, he’d thought he was a genius, too.

At 4:02 a.m., his phone buzzed. He glanced at it. It was an exchange notification.

“Your position’s risk ratio has fallen below the warning threshold.”

He shot upright. AIGENSYN’s price was surging like crazy: 0.01750, 0.01800, 0.01850. Someone in the group was shouting, “The AI sector is taking off! On-chain data is going crazy!”

Li Ming’s fingers began to tremble. He wanted to add margin, but there was no money left in his account. All 300,000 was tied up in the position.

0.01900.

He stared at the changing numbers on the screen, his mind completely blank.

0.01950.

The system alert sounded. “Your position has been forcibly liquidated.”

In that instant, Li Ming felt as if the whole world had gone silent. 300,000, gone. With 50x leverage, there was no room for a pullback; one wick had pinned him to the very top.

He turned off his phone, lay on the bed, and stared at the ceiling. Dawn was approaching outside, and the sounds of the city were gradually rising. Steam curled from the breakfast shop downstairs.

His phone buzzed again. It was a message from his girlfriend: “Good morning! It’s the weekend. Let’s go shopping today.”

五十倍杠杆的代价

凌晨三点十七分，李明盯着手机屏幕上的K线图，眼睛已经布满血丝。

他做了一件自己都觉得疯狂的事，把全部身家三十万USDT充进了合约账户，开了五十倍杠杆做空AIGENSYN。理由很简单，这个币一天涨了百分之二十二，从0.01314拉到0.01815，他觉得涨得太离谱了，肯定要回调。

"不可能一直涨的。"他自言自语，手指在屏幕上划过，看着未实现盈亏那一栏绿色的数字，心里美滋滋的。开仓价0.01750，现在价格0.01680，已经浮盈四千多了。

他点了根烟，打开微信群，发了条消息："兄弟们，空军到位，等回调请你们吃火锅。"

群里有人回复："明哥牛逼。"也有人劝他："五十倍太狠了吧，留点余地。"

李明没听。他想起上个月做空ETHFI赚的那笔，从0.52空到0.42，翻了整整三倍。那时候他也觉得自己是天才。

凌晨四点零二分，手机震了一下。他瞥了一眼，是交易所的推送。

"您的持仓风险率已低于警戒线。"

他猛地坐起来。AIGENSYN的价格像疯了一样往上冲，0.01750、0.01800、0.01850。群里有人在喊："AI赛道爆发了！链上数据疯了！"

李明的手指开始发抖。他想追加保证金，但账户里已经没有任何余钱了。三十万全部压在仓位里。

0.01900。

他看着屏幕上跳动的数字，大脑一片空白。

0.01950。

系统提示音响了。"您的持仓已被强制平仓。"

那一瞬间，李明觉得整个世界都安静了。三十万，没了。五十倍杠杆，连回调的余地都没有，一根针就把他钉死在了最高点上。

他关掉手机，躺在床上盯着天花板。窗外天快亮了，城市的声音渐渐响起来，楼下早餐店的蒸笼冒出白气。

手机又震了一下，是女朋友发来的消息："早安，今天周末，我们去逛街吧。"

李明没有回复。他翻了个身，把脸埋进枕头里。

三个月后，他在一个深夜重新打开了交易所APP。账户余额还剩两百多U，是之前忘了转走的一点零头。他看着AIGENSYN的K线，那个他做空被爆的币，现在价格已经回到了0.01617。

他深吸一口气，用那两百多U买了一点点现货。这次没有杠杆，没有合约，只有现货。

他对自己说："这次，就当交学费了。"

My assessment is that, during this BTC downturn, ETF redemptions look more like a passive consequence of falling prices and settlement friction than an active selling signal that can be independently confirmed. This assessment depends on being able to observe redemption data separately from on-chain transfers into custodial accounts. As long as the two are conflated, the market can easily misread settlement activity as institutional liquidation.

First, the facts. On November 22, PANews cited Arthur Hayes as saying that BTC had fallen below its previous interim low and that, if the Nasdaq continued to decline, the next major test could be around $50,000—this is an opinion, not an event that has already occurred. Another source said that BTC had fallen for seven weeks, briefly plunged below $58,000, and that nearly 300,000 people were liquidated within 24 hours; BlackRock's IBIT saw $541 million in outflows in a single day, a record since its launch, while ETFs collectively lost more than $3 billion in November. The same source also said that a wallet associated with BlackRock transferred 5,400 BTC and more than 70,000 ETH, worth over $400 million, to Coinbase Prime; the related account said these transfers were routine settlement of redemption flows, not active selling. It should be noted that this account comes from a single source, so the explanation that these were redemption settlements should remain attributed to that source.

Based on this, ETF redemptions, market-maker hedging, and perpetual futures funding rates form three transmission channels: redemptions create expectations of spot selling pressure, market makers reduce exposure to hedge, and leveraged liquidations then amplify volatility. On-chain transfers to custodial addresses may simply be one step in the redemption process and cannot be directly equated with selling. In my view, what is truly worth tracking is whether IBIT's daily net inflows turn positive, whether the short-term holder cost basis zone can provide support, and whether spot buying emerges after funding rates turn from positive to negative. If the Nasdaq continues to weaken and ETF outflows persist, the scenario in which the $58,000–$60,000 range comes under pressure cannot be ruled out. If spot buying emerges after funding rates turn negative, the divergence between on-chain and ETF signals may begin to narrow. The source material does not provide a specific figure for the short-term holder cost basis zone, so this indicator cannot currently be confirmed on that basis and should not be treated as an established fact. This article does not constitute investment advice.

我的判断是：这轮BTC下跌中，ETF赎回更像价格下跌后的被动结果与结算摩擦，而非可以单独确认的主动抛售信号；这个判断成立的前提，是赎回数据与链上转入托管的行为能够被分开观察。只要两者仍被混为一谈，市场就容易把结算动作误读成机构清仓。

先看事实。PANews 11月22日引述Arthur Hayes的观点称，BTC已跌破此前阶段性低点，若纳斯达克继续下跌，下一道重要考验可能在5万美元附近——这是观点，不是已发生的事实。另一素材提到，BTC跌了七周，一度砸穿5.8万美元，24小时内近30万人被清算；贝莱德IBIT单日流出5.41亿美元，创成立以来纪录，11月ETF整体失血三十多亿美元。同一素材还称，贝莱德关联钱包向Coinbase Prime转入5400枚BTC和七万多枚ETH，价值四亿多美元，相关说法称属于赎回流正常结算，并非主动砸盘。需要说明，这部分表述来自单一素材，赎回结算的解释应保留归属。

据此推断，ETF赎回、做市商对冲与永续资金费率构成三条传导链：赎回带来现货卖压预期，做市商为对冲降低敞口，杠杆清算再放大波动。链上转入托管地址，可能只是赎回流程的一环，不能直接等同于抛售。我的观察是，真正值得跟踪的是IBIT日度净流入是否转正、短期持有者成本区能否形成承接，以及资金费率是否由正转负后现货买盘出现。若纳指继续走弱且ETF流出不止，5.8万至6万美元区间承压的情景仍难排除；若资金费率转负后现货承接出现，链上与ETF信号的背离才可能收敛。本次素材未提供短期持有者成本区的具体数值，这一指标暂无法据此确认，不宜当作已确认事实。本文不构成投资建议。

【24 hours: +3.6%; one week: -5.6%: On a one-month view, ETH is still 66% below its ATH】

Trading volume has climbed to over 5% of market cap, while the FNG is just 11—some are trying to catch a rebound amid extreme fear. ETH has been bouncing between 1,592.91 and 1,743.75. Interesting, but the bottom isn't confirmed yet.

One thing matters more to me: BTCS has about $54 million in Aave loans and reduced its reported debt by roughly $10 million in 10 days, yet still warns that a drop in ETH could put collateral under pressure and potentially trigger liquidation.

That's ETH's hidden identity: it's not just something to trade—it's also the deed someone may pledge when borrowing money. When ETH falls, collateral shrinks and liquidation thresholds draw closer; when ETH rises, financing headroom opens up.

In practice, institutional leverage amplifies volatility: a drop in the coin's price can trigger forced selling, which may push it down further. The drawdown holders see could be the result of a liquidation cascade. Companies can use ETH to raise financing, and the business logic makes sense—but the debt still has to be repaid. Treating the coin's price as operating revenue is where the logic breaks down.

Remember: when looking at ETH, don't just watch whether it's rising or falling. Also ask who is using it as leveraged collateral and who might face liquidation.

Are you more worried about another drop, or a sudden rebound that leaves you on the sidelines? Feeling tempted to jump in?

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100 U control 1,000 U, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are new to trading ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you earn 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage means the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100 U of your own capital and use 10x leverage, your actual position is
worth 1,000 U. If the coin price rises 1%, your principal gains 10% (relative to your principal); conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your principal—note that losses are calculated based on the total position, including borrowed funds.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the coin price moves against you by about 10%, your principal is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not
that you only lose it all after a 10% drop; a drop of about 10% is enough to wipe you out (the exact threshold also depends on the margin ratio).

📰 BlackRock Enters the HKD Digital Fund Market: An Opportunity or Another Risk Lesson?

BlackRock has launched a Hong Kong dollar digital liquidity fund in Hong Kong. What makes it distinctive is that it supports both tokenized units recorded on a blockchain and non-tokenized units. The key is how transactions are conducted: subscriptions and redemptions can be made using digital cash, including stablecoins and tokenized deposits issued by institutions authorized by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. However, BlackRock also reminds investors that familiar risks—such as smart contract vulnerabilities and private key management—are back in the picture.

Why does this news matter?
BlackRock’s move is more than just a digital fund; it brings the rigor of traditional finance into the digital arena. For an offshore currency like the HKD, introducing digital liquidity tools could create better links with the Greater Bay Area market, especially given Hong Kong’s fintech infrastructure. But this may also mean regulators are exploring “Regulatory Sandbox 2.0”—recognizing the risks of digital currencies while allowing compliant institutions to participate in more mature ways. This is similar to the thinking behind central banks’ earlier research into central bank digital currencies (CBDCs): using traditional financial safeguards to contain risks in the digital world.

Market impact
In the short term, sentiment around BTC and ETH may get a boost from the arrival of “traditional finance heavyweights,” triggering a wave of speculation. But the market is likely to cool down quickly, since the HKD fund is essentially still an offshore product, with little connection to the main ecosystems of cryptocurrencies. More noteworthy is that this could encourage more traditional financial institutions to use the Hong Kong dollar as a test case for exploring digital liquidity tools for other fiat currencies. That means more similar products may emerge in the future, but they will also bring more complex regulatory challenges around cross-border capital flows. Historically, every new financial instrument has been accompanied by a round of risk lessons—for example, the black swan events that followed the explosive growth of Bitcoin ATMs in 2014.

💡 This news signals that digital asset management is moving from the “experimental phase” into the “compliant commercialization phase.” However, participants in cryptocurrency main-chain ecosystems should understand that the benefits of this wave will go mostly to fiat currencies and players operating within compliant frameworks. If broader geopolitical conflicts lead to tighter capital controls in the future, funds like this HKD fund could become the new darlings of offshore markets.

BlackRock在香港推出了港币数字流动性基金，这玩意儿特别之处在于既支持区块链上记录的代币化份额，也支持非代币化份额。关键在于交易方式，可以用数字现金，包括稳定币和港金局授权机构发行的代币化存款进行申购赎回。不过，BlackRock也提醒投资者，智能合约漏洞、私钥管理这类老生常谈的风险又来了。

为什么这条新闻重要？
BlackRock这次动作不是简单的数字基金，而是把传统金融的严谨玩法搬到了数字领域。对HKD这种离岸货币来说，引入数字流动性工具能更好地对接大湾区市场，尤其考虑到香港的金融科技基础。但这背后意味着监管层可能正在探索"监管沙盒2.0"——在承认数字货币风险的同时，允许合规机构用更成熟的方式参与。这和之前各国央行研究央行数字货币（CBDC）思路类似，都是想先把数字世界的风险用传统金融的防火墙挡住。

对市场的影响
对BTC和ETH来说，短期情绪面可能因"传统金融大佬入场"而出现一波炒作。但市场会很快冷静，因为HKD基金本质还是离岸产品，和加密货币主链生态关联不大。更值得关注的是，这会推动更多传统金融机构以"港币"为试点，探索其他法币的数字流动性工具。这意味着未来会有更多类似产品，但也会带来更复杂的跨境资金流动监管问题。历史上看，每次新金融工具出现，都会伴随一轮风险事件教育，比如2014年比特币ATM爆炸性增长后出现的黑天鹅。

一、价格走势分析

以太坊在过去24小时内呈现温和反弹态势，价格从1657美元附近回升至1665.75美元，涨幅约2.0%。这一反弹主要受到大规模鲸鱼买入行为的推动，一个新兴钱包从Amber Group累计吸纳了6250枚ETH，总价值约1052万美元。

从小时K线来看，ETH在1648美元至1672美元区间内运行。最近几个小时的走势相对平稳，开盘价1663.30美元，最高1668.52美元，最低1659.10美元，收于1666.35美元。成交量方面，高峰时段达到2219万美元，随后逐步回落至744万美元，显示市场参与度在反弹后有所降低。

在更大的时间框架上，以太坊面临着多重压力。Bitmine在达到5%的供应量后停止了常规周度收购计划，移除了一个重要的结构性买盘支撑。同时，以太坊基金会近期转移了2500枚ETH，带来了潜在的卖压。Chainflip黑客事件中被盗的约2910枚ETH也在通过混币器处理，增加了市场的不确定性。

二、技术指标解读

移动平均线系统显示以太坊处于弱势整理格局。7小时均线为1664.60美元，25小时均线为1672.13美元，99小时均线高达1721.47美元。价格位于所有主要均线下方，短期均线有向下发散的趋势。指数移动平均线呈现类似格局，7周期EMA为1667.41美元，25周期EMA为1669.14美元，99周期EMA为1713.92美元。

RSI指标出现积极变化。6周期RSI回升至46.27，12周期RSI为48.85，24周期RSI为47.34。三条RSI线均从低位回升至中性区域，表明短期卖压有所缓解，买方力量正在逐步恢复。KDJ指标也出现金叉迹象，K值为38.72，D值为36.50，J值为43.16，三线向上发散，为短期反弹提供了技术支撑。

以太坊市场的情绪同样受到整体加密市场低迷的拖累，但表现出一定的韧性。与比特币相比，以太坊的反弹幅度相当，但鲸鱼活动的积极性更高。大规模买入行为表明部分聪明资金认为当前价格已经具备中长期配置价值。

从链上数据来看，以太坊的超卖程度不如比特币严重，但反弹力度也相对较弱。这反映出市场对以太坊的基本面存在更多疑虑，包括Layer2竞争加剧、质押收益率变化以及监管不确定性等因素。

ETH staking funds also need liquidity｜Grayscale filing discloses redemption arrangements｜I’ll wait for 1720 before acting

I remain cautious on ETH, especially since I would not interpret “the fund can stake” as meaning new money is buying in today. The S-3 filing submitted by the Grayscale Ethereum Staking Mini ETF to the U.S. SEC on November 19 explains that the form of staking described by the fund had already met the relevant tax requirements and begun operating on October 6, 2025. The new disclosure worth noting concerns the redemption mechanism: the manager will retain some unstaked ETH as a liquidity buffer, with the proportion adjustable based on anticipated subscriptions and redemptions and the unstaking process; deferred delivery arrangements may also be used when necessary. This is about how the fund manages existing assets and the timing mismatch during redemptions—not an announcement of an Ethereum mainnet upgrade on November 19, much less an SEC guarantee of the fund’s returns.

How does this detail matter for trading? Staking can generate rewards denominated in ETH, but exiting on-chain takes time, while fund share subscriptions and redemptions and secondary-market trading each have their own pace. If many holders request redemptions at the same time, the adequacy of the buffer, the length of the unstaking queue, and how liquidity providers quote prices will all affect the fund’s premium or discount and execution costs. These factors do not necessarily trigger spot ETH selling, but they can change institutions’ risk budgets for holding ETH. Conversely, if the buffer remains ample and fund inflows recover, the staking mechanism may increase holders’ willingness to hold. Both scenarios need to be assessed using actual data; they cannot be summed up with “the higher the staking rate, the more bullish” alone.

The market has not confirmed the latter scenario. ETHUSDT on Binance is around $1,666.92, up about 2.41% over the past 24 hours, with a low of 1,618 and a high of 1,716.58; the price remains below the top of the range. Farside recorded a combined net outflow of $131.2 million from U.S. ETH funds on November 19. The page currently shows a provisional net outflow of $13.2 million for November 20, but key entries such as ETHA, ETHB, and FETH are blank, so missing data cannot be treated as zero and used to claim that outflows have clearly narrowed. Today is the weekend, and there is no new regular U.S. fund trading-day data to verify a recovery in demand. Spot price gains and institutional subscriptions and redemptions may not move in sync, which is why I am keeping my position size under control.

My price levels are to hold 1650 first, then watch 1720. Only a convincing four-hour close above 1720, followed by a retest that holds around 1700, would create a chance to test 1760. If the price then closes back below 1650 repeatedly, that would show the rebound is just oscillating within the range; a further break below 1618 would invalidate my short-term bullish view. What could overturn my cautious stance is complete subsequent fund data showing sustained net inflows, alongside a simultaneous breakout in price and volume. What would reinforce it is mounting redemption pressure, a deeper fund discount, or an officially confirmed staking-service issue. Unverified market rumors are not included as trigger conditions.

If I were trading this myself, I would not chase the price now; I would only prepare for a small spot long position. The entry trigger is a four-hour close above 1720, a retest that holds between 1700 and 1720, and complete ETH fund data on the next U.S. trading day that does not show significant net outflows. If all conditions are met, I would use no more than 5% of total capital, with no leverage. I would sell half at 1760, sell half of the remainder at 1820, and use a trailing stop based on four-hour lows for the rest. After entering, I would exit at a loss if a four-hour close falls below 1650; I would also exit the entire position early if Grayscale or its custodian disclosed a major redemption or staking issue. If the conditions are not all met, I will stay in cash; I will never present an observation as an executed trade.

我对ETH维持谨慎，尤其不会把“基金可以质押”解读成今天有新钱买入。灰度Ethereum Staking Mini ETF于11月19日向美国SEC提交的S-3文件，说明该基金描述的质押形式早在2025年10月6日已满足相关税务条件并开始运行。文件的新增披露值得看的是赎回机制：管理方会保留一部分未质押的ETH作为流动性缓冲，比例可随预期申赎和解质押流程调整；必要时也可能采用延后交付安排。这里说的是基金如何管理存量资产与赎回时差，不是11月19日宣布ETH主网升级，更不是SEC替基金收益作保证。

这个细节对交易有什么用？质押能产生以ETH计价的奖励，但链上退出需要时间，而基金份额的申赎和二级市场买卖有自己的节奏。若大量持有人同时要求赎回，缓冲是否足够、解质押排队多长、流动性提供方如何报价，都会影响基金折溢价和执行成本。它们不必然引发ETH现货抛售，却会改变机构持有ETH的风险预算。相反，若缓冲长期充足、基金申购回升，质押机制可能增加持有意愿。两种情况都要看实际数据，不能只用“质押率越高越利好”一句话概括。

市场当前未确认后一种情景。币安ETHUSDT约1666.92美元，近24小时上涨约2.41%，低点1618、高点1716.58；价格仍在区间高点下方。Farside记录11月19日美国ETH基金合计净流出1.312亿美元。11月20日页面暂列净流出1320万美元，但ETHA、ETHB和FETH等主要栏位为空，不能把缺失当成零并宣称流出已明显收窄。今天是周末，也没有新的美国基金常规交易日数据来验证需求恢复。现货上涨与机构申赎可能不同步，这正是我控制仓位的原因。

我的价格条件是先守1650，再看1720。四小时有效站上1720、回踩1700附近不破，才有机会试1760；若随后连续收回1650下方，说明反弹只是在区间内摇摆；若再跌破1618，短线偏多想法失效。能推翻我谨慎判断的，是基金后续完整数据持续转入净流入、价格和成交量同步突破；能强化谨慎判断的，是赎回压力扩大、基金折价加深或出现官方确认的质押服务异常。未经披露的市场传闻不纳入触发条件。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与追高，方向仅准备现货轻仓做多。入场触发为四小时收盘高于1720、回踩1700至1720守住，并且下个美国交易日ETH基金完整数据没有显示显著净流出；满足后最多用总资金5%，不加杠杆。到1760减半，到1820再减剩余一半，余仓按四小时低点移动止盈。进场后四小时收盘跌破1650就止损平仓；若灰度或托管方披露重大赎回、质押异常，也提前全平。条件未齐就继续空仓，绝不把观察写成已成交。

title: 交易干货 | 满仓一把梭的数学期望，看完你还敢吗
subTitle:
假设一个策略胜率60%，对了赚50%，错了亏50%。听上去不错吧？
如果每次满仓，算一下长期结果：60%×50% - 40%×50% = 每笔期望+10%，
看着是正期望。但注意路径：连错两次就是-75%，需要+300%才能回本。
正期望的策略+满仓执行=大概率破产，这就是赌徒破产定理在币圈的
日常上演。

同样的策略，改成每次只动20%仓位：连错两次-18%，毫无杀伤力，
长期期望照吃。策略没变，变的只是仓位，生死就不同。

记住这个不等式：你的长期收益 ≈ 策略期望 × 你能活多久。仓位决定
后者。活得久的人，才有资格谈期望值。

translatedData.title: Trading Insights | The Math of Going All-In—Dare You After Seeing This?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, earning 50% on a win and losing 50% on a loss. Sounds pretty good, right?
If you go all-in each time, here’s the long-term calculation: 60% × 50% - 40% × 50% = an expected gain of 10% per trade,
It looks like a positive expectancy. But consider the path: two losses in a row mean -75%, and you need +300% to break even.
A positive-expectancy strategy + going all-in = a high probability of bankruptcy. That’s the gambler’s ruin theorem playing out in crypto
every day.

Same strategy, but use only 20% of your capital each time: two losses in a row = -18%, hardly a blow,
and you still capture the long-term expectancy. The strategy hasn’t changed—only your position size. That’s the difference between survival and ruin.

A stop-loss isn’t a prediction—it’s accepting a tolerable outcome in advance.
① Set a fixed maximum loss per trade; don’t let emotions make it bigger.
② If you hit your daily loss limit, call it a day. Don’t take it out on the market.
③ After several losing trades in a row, pause. If the setup isn’t clear, don’t trade.
First, make sure you’re still in the game; then think about what the market does next.

🔥 ETH’s rebound momentum is worth watching! Ethereum’s true value is about more than just a rising price

The cryptocurrency market has seen sharp volatility recently, and $ETH  has also rebounded after a steep decline.

According to market data from November 22, ETH was trading at around $1,680, up approximately 3%–4% over 24 hours (figures may vary slightly depending on the data source and reporting time).

But I believe what makes Ethereum truly worth studying is not just its short-term price, but the entire blockchain ecosystem behind it.

📌 1. Does ETH’s rebound mean capital is flowing back in?

ETH’s price is influenced by market risk appetite, ETF fund flows, derivatives leverage, and the broader cryptocurrency market.
A short-term rebound is certainly worth watching, but it’s also important to see whether trading volume and spot buying continue to increase.

📌 2. The Ethereum ecosystem is still worth watching over the long term

Ethereum is more than just a cryptocurrency. It is also a key infrastructure layer for many DeFi, stablecoin, NFT, and Layer 2 applications.
As blockchain applications continue to develop, ETH’s long-term value should also be assessed based on network usage demand, transaction activity, and ecosystem growth.

📌 3. DeFi security issues can’t be ignored

On November 21, a security incident involving the cross-chain protocol Chainflip’s Ethereum Vault resulted in approximately $4.86 million in assets being transferred out.
Chainflip subsequently activated security mode, suspending deposits, withdrawals, and swaps.
It’s important to clarify that the incident involved Chainflip’s cross-chain protocol vault; it does not mean that the Ethereum mainnet was hacked.

This is also a reminder that when using DeFi or cross-chain services, we need to assess not only potential returns, but also smart contract risks, validator signing mechanisms, and asset custody risks.

📌 4. Three things to watch next

1. Whether ETH can hold steadily within its recent rebound range.
2. Whether U.S. spot ETH ETFs return to net inflows.
3. Whether Ethereum’s DeFi activity, on-chain transactions, and Layer 2 ecosystem continue to grow.

🔥 Market outlook
I believe the investment case for ETH can’t be judged solely by short-term price movements.
BTC is more like an important store of value in the cryptocurrency market, while ETH has both asset characteristics and a vast blockchain application ecosystem.
What’s worth watching in the future is whether Ethereum can turn its technological advantages into real-world demand.
💬 Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments!

🔥 ETH 反彈力道值得關注！以太坊真正的價值，不只是幣價上漲

最近加密貨幣市場出現劇烈震盪，$ETH  也在急跌後迎來反彈。

根據 11 月 22 日市場資料，ETH 約在 1,680 美元附近交易，24 小時漲幅約 3%～4%（不同資料來源及統計時間略有差異）。

但我認為，以太坊真正值得研究的，不只是短期價格，而是它背後的整個區塊鏈生態。

📌 一、ETH 反彈是否代表資金重新回流？

ETH 的價格受到市場風險偏好、ETF 資金流向、衍生品槓桿及整體加密貨幣市場影響。
短線反彈固然值得關注，但還需要觀察成交量及現貨買盤是否持續增加。

📌 二、以太坊生態仍然值得長期觀察

Ethereum 不只是一種加密貨幣，它也是許多 DeFi、穩定幣、NFT 及 Layer 2 應用的重要基礎設施。
隨著區塊鏈應用持續發展，ETH 的長期價值也需要從網路使用需求、交易活動及生態成長來評估。

📌 三、DeFi 安全問題不能忽視

11 月 21 日，跨鏈協議 Chainflip 的 Ethereum Vault 發生約 486 萬美元資產遭轉出的安全事件。
Chainflip 隨後啟動安全模式，暫停存款、提款及交換服務。
這件事需要特別說明：遭遇事件的是 Chainflip 的跨鏈協議金庫，並不代表 Ethereum 主網遭到駭客攻擊。

這也提醒我們，使用 DeFi 或跨鏈服務時，除了關注收益，也必須評估智能合約、驗證者簽名機制及資產託管風險。

📌 四、接下來值得觀察的三個方向

1. ETH 能否穩定守住近期反彈區間。
2. 美國現貨 ETH ETF 是否恢復資金淨流入。
3. Ethereum 的 DeFi 活動、鏈上交易及 Layer 2 生態是否持續成長。

🔥 市場觀點
我認為 ETH 的投資邏輯不能只看短線漲跌。
BTC 更像是加密貨幣市場的重要價值錨，而 ETH 除了資產屬性，也承載了龐大的區塊鏈應用生態。
未來值得觀察的是：以太坊能否把技術優勢轉化為實際使用需求。
💬 歡迎留言討論！

Gas is the unit Ethereum uses to measure how much computational power a transaction consumes. A standard ETH transfer uses 21,000 Gas.
When a transfer fails, the Gas already used is generally not refunded—the network has already done the work, after all.
If your transfer isn’t urgent, try avoiding peak times to save quite a bit on Gas fees.

The U.S. added 165,000 nonfarm jobs in October, and the unemployment rate was 4.1%, indicating that the labor market remains relatively stable. But CPI rose 0.4% month over month, while PPI was up 6.5% year over year, showing that price pressures remain pronounced. Industrial output fell 0.4%, although manufacturing still grew 0.3%. This points to a mixed economy, but not one weak enough to make the Fed stop tightening policy.
The FOMC minutes released on November 18 remained hawkish. Market bets on a 25-basis-point rate hike in December climbed to 90.7%. As of November 17, bets on cumulative rate hikes of 50 basis points before the January 2027 meeting had reached 70.9%. Put simply, the market is no longer too concerned about whether rates will rise; it’s worried about how much further they’ll go up.

🛢️ Global Markets: The Dollar Rose as Gold, U.S. Stocks, and Crypto Fell

Fed research reassesses productivity and interest rates | Not a rate-cut signal | ETH rebound still needs confirmation

My stance is cautious and observant; I would not trade a research note as “the Fed is going to cut rates.” On November 20, the Federal Reserve website published a FEDS Note titled “Will a Productivity Boom Push Up Interest Rates?” The two authors use a model based on historical data to study anticipated productivity improvements. Their model finds that after a related shock, the 10-year Treasury yield and a measure of the long-run equilibrium real interest rate decline; short-term rates may temporarily rise, but the term premium falls by more. The authors clearly state that these are research findings and do not represent the views of the Federal Reserve Board. The paper also does not give a rate decision for the next meeting, much less discuss a fair price for ETH. To turn “long-term rates may decline” directly into “the central bank is turning dovish now” would conflate models, policy, and market pricing.

Why is this still worth the crypto market’s attention? Risk assets such as BTC and ETH are highly sensitive to financing costs, real yields, and investors’ willingness to take on risk. If long-term real rates decline while risk appetite remains stable, the opportunity cost of holding highly volatile assets may fall. But if rates are declining because the economy is weakening and credit risk is rising, ETH may not benefit. The research also suggests that the recent rise in long-term rates cannot simply be attributed to expectations of productivity gains from AI. That means we need to keep distinguishing between the term premium, inflation expectations, and the real policy rate, rather than using a single macro narrative to explain every fluctuation in crypto prices. This transmission pathway is my own inference about the mechanism, not a buy signal for ETH from the paper.

The market has already recovered from its lows. Checking Binance spot prices, ETH/USDT is around $1,661.36, up about 5.5% in 24 hours, with a low of $1,572.58 and a high of $1,716.58. After rebounding to around $1,716, it failed to break higher; the current price is below the daily high. I have no evidence that today’s gain was directly triggered by this November 20 research. Nor should the fund flows be overinterpreted: according to Farside, ETH funds saw a combined net outflow of $131.2 million on November 19. The November 20 table currently shows an outflow of $13.2 million, but key entries such as ETHA, ETHB, and FETH are blank, so this is not a complete picture for the day. If the data is later filled in and still shows substantial outflows, while ETH fails to hold $1,650, the optimism inspired by macro research may not be enough to absorb selling pressure.

My levels to watch are $1,650, $1,720, and $1,760. If $1,650 holds, the rebound from the lows remains intact. ETH needs to hold above $1,720 and then retest it without breaking down to improve the odds of the rebound continuing. If the price breaks decisively above $1,720 and fund flows stabilize, my current cautious view would be invalidated. If real rates continue to rise, funds keep seeing net outflows, or ETH falls below $1,600, the rebound thesis should also be abandoned.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and consider only an unleveraged spot long. The entry trigger would be ETH moving above $1,720 and then holding firm on a retest of the $1,700–$1,720 range, while BTC does not lose $59,000 again. If the conditions are not met, I would remain in cash; this plan should not be mistaken for an executed trade or a return.

美联储研究重估生产率与利率｜并非降息信号｜ETH反弹仍等确认

我的态度是谨慎观望，不把一篇研究札记交易成“美联储要降息”。美联储网站11月20日刊登FEDS Notes《生产率繁荣会推高利率吗？》。两位作者用历史数据模型研究预期中的生产率改善，得到的模型结果是：相关冲击出现后，十年期国债收益率和衡量长期均衡实际利率的一项指标下降；短期利率可能暂时上升，但期限溢价下降幅度更大。作者明确指出，这是研究结论，观点不代表联储理事会。论文也没有给出下一次会议的利率决定，更没有讨论ETH的合理价格。把“长期利率可能下降”直接写成“当下央行转鸽”会混淆模型、政策与市场报价。

这件事为何仍值得加密市场关注？BTC和ETH等风险资产对融资成本、真实收益率以及投资者愿意承担的风险高度敏感。若长期真实利率下降而风险偏好稳定，持有高波动资产的机会成本可能降低；但如果利率下行是因为经济转弱、信用风险上升，ETH未必受益。研究还提示，近期长端利率上升不能简单归因于AI带来的预期生产率提升，这意味着我们需要继续分辨期限溢价、通胀预期和真实政策利率，而不是用单一宏观叙事解释所有币价波动。传导路径是我的机制推断，不是论文给ETH发出的买入信号。

市场实际已从低位修复。核对币安现货时，ETH/USDT约1661.36美元，24小时上涨约5.5%，低点1572.58、高点1716.58。反弹到1716附近后未继续突破，现价低于日高；我没有证据说今天的涨幅由这篇11月20日研究直接触发。资金面也不宜过度解读：Farside的11月19日ETH基金合计净流出1.312亿美元；11月20日表格暂列流出1320万美元，但ETHA、ETHB、FETH等主要栏位空白，不是完整当日结论。假如后续补齐数据仍大幅流出，且ETH守不住1650，宏观研究带来的想象不足以承接卖盘。

我的观察位是1650、1720、1760。1650若维持，属于低位反弹仍在；1720要站稳并回踩不破，才能提高反弹延续概率；跌破1650且反抽无力，我会把风险位移到1600与1573附近。若价格有效突破1720且基金流向转稳，当前谨慎判断被推翻；若真实利率继续上行、基金持续净流出，或ETH跌破1600，也应撤销反弹假设。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向仅考虑无杠杆现货试多。入场触发是ETH站上1720后回踩1700至1720区间企稳，同时BTC没有再失守59000；仓位占总资金最多2%。第一目标1760，到位减半，第二目标1820，余仓分批平仓。入场后跌破1660就止损；若收复1720又迅速跌回1700以下，提前平仓。账户单次风险控制在0.4%以内，条件未触发维持空仓，不把计划当作成交或收益。

#ETH

🚨 $ETH 'S $440M OTC WHALE IS CUTTING LOSSES — 12,000 ETH HIT THE EXIT 🦈

📌 The footprint is unmistakable — this OTC desk accumulated 163,405 $ETH at $2,691 and 4,000 $cbBTC at $74,004, a combined $736M position. In one two-hour window, 12,000 ETH (~$27.4M) and 330 cbBTC (~$24.3M) were pushed onto exchange and institutional venues. 🌊

💡 That's textbook distribution — coins migrating from cold storage into sell-side liquidity, with $cbBTC near its $74,004 break-even while $ETH stays underwater beneath $2,691. The whale is de-risking rather than defending, and when smart money stops holding a level, the book underneath thins fast.

The cryptocurrency market experienced another brutal week, with Bitcoin falling below $60,000, Ethereum facing selling pressure, and institutional investors reducing their exposure to crypto ETFs.

Despite a late-week recovery, market sentiment remains extremely cautious. Is this a temporary correction or the beginning of a deeper bear market?

1. BITCOIN MARKET UPDATE (BTC)

Bitcoin experienced significant volatility this week.

Bitcoin dropped below $60,000.
Reuters reported a fall below $57,742 on November 21.
BTC subsequently recovered above $60,000.
Institutional selling and weak global risk sentiment contributed to market pressure.

Market outlook: Bitcoin needs sustained buying pressure and stronger market structure before a bullish reversal can be confirmed.

2. ETHEREUM MARKET UPDATE (ETH)

Ethereum also experienced considerable selling pressure.

ETH struggled to maintain the $2,000 level.
Institutional ETF withdrawals added pressure.
Traders are watching whether ETH can regain important psychological price levels.

Ethereum's recovery will depend on stronger spot demand and improved market sentiment.

3. MAJOR ALTCOIN MARKET

Major altcoins continue to face volatility.

BNB, XRP, SOL and other leading cryptocurrencies remain sensitive to Bitcoin's direction.

The important question is whether altcoins can recover independently or whether Bitcoin must stabilize first.

4. INSTITUTIONAL ETF OUTFLOWS

Institutional demand remains a major concern.

Recent November data showed more than $3.4 billion in net outflows from US spot Bitcoin ETFs through November 19.

Bitcoin and Ethereum investment products have both experienced substantial withdrawals.

This suggests that institutional investors are becoming more cautious during the market correction.

5. MASSIVE CRYPTO LIQUIDATIONS

Leveraged traders have faced significant pressure.

When Bitcoin drops rapidly, leveraged long positions can be liquidated, creating additional selling pressure.

This can produce a chain reaction:

Bitcoin price declines.
Leveraged long positions get liquidated.
Selling pressure increases.
Altcoins experience further volatility.
Market confidence weakens.

Remember: High leverage can turn a normal correction into a much bigger market event.

6. WHY IS THE CRYPTO MARKET FALLING?

Several factors are influencing the current market:

Federal Reserve interest-rate uncertainty.
Institutional ETF outflows.
Weak global risk appetite.
Selling pressure across technology stocks.
Higher borrowing costs and bond yields.
Reduced confidence in speculative assets.
Futures deleveraging and forced liquidations.

These are contributing factors, not proof of one single cause.

7. FEDERAL RESERVE AND MACROECONOMIC OUTLOOK

The Federal Reserve's October meeting minutes highlighted continuing inflation concerns and uncertainty around future interest-rate decisions.

Markets are watching upcoming US economic releases, particularly GDP and PCE inflation data.

Higher-for-longer interest rates could continue to put pressure on risky assets, including cryptocurrencies.

US GDP and PCE inflation releases.
Bitcoin trading volume.

These indicators could determine whether the market stabilizes or experiences another correction.

The late-week Bitcoin rebound is encouraging, but one recovery move does not confirm a bullish trend reversal.

Strong Bitcoin spot buying.
Improvement in institutional ETF flows.

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Is the Fuel Cost of a Blockchain?
translatedData.subTitle:
You have to pay Gas fees to transfer funds or mint an NFT. Who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transfers, trades, running
contracts) uses computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people rush to execute transactions, and the higher the gas price (the unit price of Gas).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → skyrocketing Gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they choose late-night hours or quiet market periods for on-chain operations. The same operation can cost half as much.

180,000 ETH in collateral, 214 million USDT in debt, and a liquidation price of $1,401—these three numbers say more about where ETH stands right now than today's 6.22% bullish candle.

First, the position itself. This whale's liquidation level wasn't this tight originally. It was only today, at $1,605, that they borrowed another 22 million U and bought the dip with over 13,000 ETH, pushing the liquidation price all the way up to $1,401. Many people think of “adding to a position” as reducing risk, but this move did the exact opposite: more collateral, more borrowing, and a higher liquidation threshold. What they really did was trade their original safety margin for time—using more leverage to bet that the price won't turn back. At the current price of $1,655.59, there's only about a 15% buffer to $1,401. If ETH gives back just over two-thirds of today's gains, this position, worth around $300 million, will be in liquidation territory. 🧊

Next, funding rates—this is the set of numbers I think people should be paying the most attention to today. The price rose 6.22%, but the perpetual funding rate is still -0.0005%/8h. Annualized over three periods a day, it remains negative, which means that longs not only don't have to pay a premium, they actually receive a little money. In other words, there aren't many leveraged longs scrambling to get in and pay for it during this rally. So who's pushing the price up? A more plausible explanation is short covering plus spot buying, rather than newly emerging confidence among longs. Account data shows that long accounts make up 64.7%. That may look lively, but the number of accounts has never been the same as the strength of leverage—if more than 60% of accounts are long but funding is still negative, that suggests most of them aren't increasing leverage, or are simply holding spot.

The third dimension is the open-interest structure. Open interest is 3.847 billion USDT, with 24-hour trading volume at 8.249 billion. The volume-to-open-interest ratio is around 2.1, indicating active turnover but no one-way buildup of positions. This fits the picture of “short covering driving up the price”: money is changing hands quickly, but hasn't settled into new directional positions. So this rebound looks more like it squeezed out a group of short sellers than a real shift in the balance between bulls and bears. There's another on-chain data point worth comparing: an address suspected of being linked to a hacker sold 5,270 ETH and bought them back at a lower price, currently sitting on $2.13 million in unrealized profit. This shows that some people on-chain are trading the swings rather than simply holding. 🔍

Finally, the risk—and the part that's easiest to overlook. A position of 180,000 ETH is sitting there with a liquidation price of $1,401. That affects not just the fate of this whale, but also the market's microstructure. The closer the price gets to this level, the earlier liquidation engines and market makers will start positioning defensive sell orders. In other words, the real selling pressure won't wait until the price falls below $1,401; it will start being built in as the price approaches. This “pre-positioned selling pressure” isn't visible under normal conditions, but can magnify a drop as soon as the market weakens. It's also worth remembering that they already demonstrated a “add leverage when the price falls” pattern today. If ETH drops below $1,600 again, they may well do the same thing, pushing the liquidation level even higher. The risk is accumulating, not being cleared.

My take is that the 6.22% move at $1,655 looks more like a defensive rebound around the liquidation level than the start of a trend reversal. The real signal that the bulls are back would be funding rates turning positive and staying there—not another story about a large trader borrowing money to buy the dip. Until then, chasing this rally doesn't offer great risk-reward. The $1,401 level, on the other hand, is worth noting—it isn't just one person's private concern; it's currently one of the market's most vulnerable points. ⚠️ The lesson of leveraged markets is always the same: liquidations don't come with advance notice, and position management matters more than directional predictions when it comes to surviving until the next cycle.

18万枚 ETH 抵押、2.14 亿 USDT 债务、清算价 1401 美元——这三个数字比今天那根 6.22% 的阳线更能说明 ETH 现在站在什么位置。

先说这个仓位本身。这位巨鲸原本的清算线没这么紧张，是今天在 1605 的位置又借了 2200 万 U、抄了 1.3 万多枚 ETH，才把清算价一路推到 1401。很多人把“补仓”理解成降低风险，这笔操作恰恰相反：抵押更多、借更多，清算线是往上抬的。他真正做的事情，是把原本的安全垫换成了时间——用更高的杠杆，去赌价格别回头。现价 1655.59 到 1401，中间只有约 15% 的缓冲。ETH 只要回吐今天这根阳线的三分之二多，这个 3 亿美元级别的仓位就会进入清算视野。 🧊

再看资金费率，这才是我觉得今天最不该被忽略的一组数。价格涨了 6.22%，永续费率却还是 -0.0005%/8h，按一天三期折算年化仍在负值区间，意思是做多的人不但不用付溢价，还能收到一点点钱。换句话说，这波上涨里没有多少杠杆多头在抢筹付费。那价格是谁抬的？更合理的解释是空头回补 + 现货承接，而不是新增的多头信心。账户数据显示多头账户占比 64.7%，看着很热闹，但账户数从来不等于杠杆强度——六成多的多头账户，撑不起一个正的资金费率，说明他们大多没在加杠杆，或者压根就是现货。

第三个维度看持仓结构。持仓量 38.47 亿 USDT，24 小时成交 82.49 亿，成交/持仓比在 2.1 附近，属于换手很活跃、但持仓没有单向堆积的状态。这跟“空头平仓推价”的图景是吻合的：钱在快速转手，但没有沉淀成新的方向性头寸。所以这波反弹的性质，更像是把一批做空的人挤出去，而不是多空天平发生了实质翻转。链上还有另一条值得对照的信息：有疑似黑客地址卖出 5270 枚 ETH 又在更低位置买回，目前浮盈 213 万美元。这说明链上确实有人在用这波波动做波段，而不是死拿。 🔍

最后是风险点，也是最容易被忽略的一层。一个 18 万枚 ETH 的仓位摆在那里，清算价 1401，它改变的不只是这位巨鲸的命运，还有市场的微观结构。价格越靠近这条线，清算引擎和做市商的防御性卖压就会越提前布置——也就是说，真正的抛压不是等跌破 1401 才出现，而是在接近它的时候就开始预埋。这种“预定好的卖压”，平时看不出来，一旦行情转弱就会放大跌幅。同时也要记住，他今天已经演示过一次“跌了就加杠杆”的行为模式，如果 ETH 再回到 1600 下方，同样的操作很可能再来一遍，清算线还会继续往上抬，风险是在累积而不是释放。

我的判断是：1655 这个位置的 6.22%，目前更像一场围绕清算线的防守型反弹，而不是趋势反转的起点。真正能证明多头回来的信号，是资金费率由负转正并且站稳，而不是再出现一个大户借钱抄底的新闻。在那之前，追这波的性价比不高，反而是 1401 那条线值得记在备忘录里——它不是某个人的私事，它是这个市场当前最脆弱的一个点。 ⚠️ 杠杆市场的教训一向是，清算不会提前通知，仓位管理比方向判断更决定你能不能活到下一轮。

Let me give you an example: if you only have 100 U in your account, how can you turn it into 1,000 U? If you use Martingale, even if you put up just a dozen or so U in margin per trade and keep your liquidation price very low, when you finally catch an opportunity, you’ll only make a few U in profit.

translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and market swings eat away their capital.

In fact, staying out of the market is the only position with zero losses. If you can’t make sense of the market, stay out,
Stay out when bulls and bears are battling it out, and after a string of losing trades—money saved at these three moments
can be more than most traders make.

You may be tired of the hunting analogy, but it’s true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes only a second. Keep your capital ready, and you’ll have ammunition when an opportunity comes. Hold on to your bullets.

截至北京时间十一月二十二日中午十二点，以太坊报价一千六百六十四点五美元。过去二十四小时内，以太坊从一千六百八十四美元附近持续走低至一千五百四十三美元的阶段低点，随后出现技术性反弹，最高回升至一千六百九十美元区域，目前在一千六百六十美元附近窄幅整理。

从小时线来看，以太坊经历了五个交易时段的连续下行。价格从一千六百八十四点四九美元逐步跌至一千六百六十二点四四美元，跌幅约百分之一点三。成交量在下跌过程中明显放大，第二个时段成交额达到两千一百四十九万美元，为近期高点，随后逐步回落至一千一百四十七万美元，显示低位承接力度有限。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临多重利空因素叠加。以太坊基金会关联钱包再次出售两千五百枚以太坊，持续增加市场供给压力。更令市场失望的是，备受期待的Glamsterdam升级已被推迟至二零二七年，这意味着短期内缺乏重大利好催化。以太坊的市值已跌出全球资产前一百名，反映出市场对其信心的持续走弱。

translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% of their time reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your reasoning), what went right or wrong (in your execution),
and what you’ll do differently next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be amazed to discover that your losses…
The same kinds of mistakes keep showing up in your trade log—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or never being able to hold on to winning trades.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—go through your trading records.
